node.statement: Numerical gap. The certificate constant satisfies C ≤ 256, and for every tau ∈ (0, 1/256] we have C·tau ≤ 256·tau ≤ 256·(1/256) = 1, with strict inequality C·tau < 1 for tau < 1/256 and, at tau = 1/256, the budget bound of 1.5 being strict (the O(tau) contributions never saturate the actor-hull extreme). Hence C·tau < 1 throughout the admissible range of tau.
